summary: Reviewed native clock/control bridge is published and building its clean CI reference. IMU publication passes the local native-client and coverage gates; independent review is next.

active.title: Native IMU publication review
active.detail: Working tree: both native C++ client modes pass, including actual IMU sample readiness, scoped names, frame/sequence fields, all covariance arrays and exact post-control time. Full gate: 42 Rust tests, 9 gate tests, 890/892 lines and 1273/1290 regions. Dynamic sensor lifecycle, explicit frame IDs and topic repair remain open.

active.title: First integrated milestone checklist
active.detail: Done: Bevy stepping, Rapier sphere/box state, IMU, updated SDF loader and CLI. Remaining: stable entity hierarchy; clock/pose/IMU transport and control with C++ clients; joint/force/remove behavior; TPE; offline resources; sensor rate/noise/reset checks; equal-work reference comparison and performance report.
